notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS

The Eagle Mountain City Council will hold public hearings on November 4, 2026, at 7:00 PM or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The City Council will receive public comments concerning the following items:


Oak Hollow and Parkway Crossroads Rezone:

-	The Eagle Mountain City Council will conduct public hearings for proposed Future Land Use Map and Zoning Map amendments. These properties are located within the Oak Hollow development and Parkway Crossroads area. Approximately 41 acres of land are included in this proposal. The properties in question, along with the specific zoning and future land use designations proposed for each property, including a map, can be found by scanning the QR code provided below or at http://eaglemountain.gov/rezone/. EMC Point of Contact: Planner, Mickie Mills: mmills@eaglemountain.gov

 


Amendments to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code:

-	EMMC 17.60.085 and 17.60.100 - Artificial Turf and Residential Landscape Requirements: A proposal to adopt Section 17.60.085 regarding artificial turf and amend Section 17.60.100 Residential Landscape Requirements. EMC Point of Contact: Senior Planner, David Stroud: dstroud@eaglemountain.gov


Materials for public hearing items may be viewed within three days of the meeting on the city website and at the Eagle Mountain City Recorder's Office, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, UT, during normal business hours, Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. If you need special accommodation to participate in the meeting, please call the City Recorder's Office at 801.789.6611.  Open portions of the meeting can be viewed at www.eaglemountain.gov. 

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN ALL CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS.


Certificate of Posting
The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above public hearing notice was posted on this 23rd day of October, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain City website, www.eaglemountain.gov, and posted to the Utah State public notice website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie A. Messerly
City Recorder

EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARINGS


The Eagle Mountain City Council will hold public hearings on October 20, 2026, at 7:00 PM or as soon thereafter as business allows, in the Eagle Mountain City Council Chambers, 1650 E Stagecoach Run, Eagle Mountain, Utah 84005.  The City Council will receive public comments concerning the following items:

Amendment to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code: 

-	EMMC Titles 16 and 17: Consideration of an amendment to add a plat notation requirement for wildland urban interface (WUI) lots to EMMC 16.25.040 (Application) and corresponding definitions to 17.10.030 (Definitions). It also amends EMMC 17.60.040 (General Landscape Provisions) to permit removal of vegetation from WUI lots, as required by Utah Code § 10-20-619(6) (amended by 2026 HB 215). 
EMC Point of Contact: Elizabeth Fewkes: efewkes@eaglemountain.gov.

notices.title: Public Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
EAGLE MOUNTAIN
CITY COUNCIL MEETING

OCTOBER 20, 2026, 4:00 PM
EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
1650 E STAGECOACH RUN, EAGLE MOUNTAIN, UT 84005

4:00 PM WORK SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

1.	DISCUSSION AND INFORMATION ITEMS
	This is an opportunity to provide information to the City Council. These items are for information only and do not require action by the City Council.

	1.A.	DISCUSSION - MAP Funding Capacity and Tier Prioritization
(anticipated time 15 minutes)

	1.B.	DISCUSSION - Alternative Energy Overlay Zone Revisions
(anticipated time 10 minutes)

	1.C.	DISCUSSION - Corrigan Farms Development Agreement
(anticipated time 30 minutes)

2.	CITY MANAGER INFORMATION ITEMS
	This is an opportunity for the City Manager to provide information to the City Council. 

3.	AGENDA REVIEW
	The City Council will review items on the Consent Agenda and Policy Session Agenda.

4.	ADJOURN TO A CLOSED SESSION
	The City Council will adjourn into a Closed Session for the purpose of discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation; the character, professional competence, or physical or mental health of an individual; the purchase, lease, sale, or exchange of real property; a proposed development agreement, project proposal, or financing proposal related to the development of land owned by the state or a political subdivision; and/or the deployment of security personnel, devices, or systems, pursuant to Section 52-4-205(1) of the Utah Code, Annotated.

7:00 PM POLICY SESSION - CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS

5.	CALL TO ORDER

6.	PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

7.	INFORMATION ITEMS/UPCOMING EVENTS

8.	PUBLIC COMMENTS
	Time has been set aside for the public to express their ideas, concerns, and comments. 
(Please limit your comments to three minutes each.)

9.	CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR ITEMS
	Time has been set aside for the City Council and Mayor to make comments.

CONSENT AGENDA

10.	BOND RELEASES

	10.A.	Harmony Phase A, Plat 15 - Fencing 


	10.B.	Firefly NPA 8 Phase A, Plat 3 - Into Warranty 

	10.C.	Firefly NPA 8 Phase A, Plat 4 - Into Warranty

	10.D.	Firefly NPA 8 Phase A, Plat 5 - Into Warranty 

	10.E.	Overland Village 2 Phase A, Plat 11 - Into Warranty 

	10.F.	Harmony Phase A, Plat 15 - Out of Warranty 

	10.G.	Harmony Phase A, Rachel Way & Ira Hodges Roadway - Out of Warranty

11.	CHANGE ORDERS

	11.A.	CHANGE ORDER - Airport Well #9 Drilling, Lang Equipment - Change Order #1

	11.B.	CHANGE ORDER - Trailhead and Pony Express Traffic Signal - Change Orders #1 - #3

12.	MINUTES

	12.A.	September 29, 2026 Minutes - City Council Project Planning Session

	12.B.	October 6, 2026 Minutes - Regular City Council Meeting

	12.C.	October 8, 2026 Minutes - City Council Budget Work Session

13.	RESOLUTIONS

	13.A.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Recognizing the Eagle Mountain Community Chaplain Program

	13.B.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving a License Agreement for Encroachment with Pony Express Land Development, Inc

	13.C.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving a Reimbursement Agreement with Will-Power UT, LLC

	13.D.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Quicksilver Solar Community Reinvestment Project Area Interlocal Agreement between Eagle Mountain City and the Utah County Community Reinvestment Agency

SCHEDULED ITEMS

14.	CORRIGAN FARMS REZONE

	14.A.	ORDINANCE - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Corrigan Farms

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Senior Planner, David Stroud) Corrigan Farms LLC seeks to rezone parcel number 59:068:0006 to add the RTI overlay zone to the property to allow it to potentially develop a data center project with a natural gas power plant.

	14.B.	ORDINANCE - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah Approving the Corrigan Farms Development Agreement

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Attorney, Marcus Draper) The proposed agreement accompanies the rezone of a 41-acre parcel owned by Corrigan Farms LLC to the RTI Overlay Zone and establishes development and infrastructure requirements for the anticipated data center project. Corrigan Farms LLC owns a 41 acre parcel in the southern portion of our City. The parcel abuts other data center properties, as well as ENYO Energy properties. This agreement was prepared in conjunction with the rezone application for the parcel to the RTI overlay zone. It is consistent with other data center development agreements, except that it is for 20 years instead of 40. It is anticipated that the applicant will construct 2 data centers with an on site natural gas power plant. Article V of the agreement governs the infrastructure requirements to insure success of the project. The language recognizes that there are still unknowns regarding the specifics and maintains flexibility while insuring that the City has the final say.

The Development Agreement came before the Council for consideration on October 6th. The Council gave feedback related to concerns that it had for the development. Changes have been made to the agreement to account for the feedback. The matter is on for discussion to make sure that the changes address the previously raised concerns.

15.	RESOLUTIONS

	15.A.	RESOLUTION - A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process for a Portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108, Designated as 'Significant Real Property' Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060

BACKGROUND: (Presented by City Recorder Lacie A. Messerly) This item is a request to dispose of a portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108 designated as 'Significant Real Property' in accordance with EMMC 3.30.060. The application, submitted by Allen Barney and various residents pertains to approximately .85 acre (37,026 sq/ft) of property located at Eagle Park Phase I.

16.	ORDINANCES/PUBLIC HEARINGS

	16.A.	ORDINANCE/PUBLIC HEARING - An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Amending Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Section 16.25.040 Application, 17.10.030 Definitions, and 17.60.040 General Landscape Provisions

BACKGROUND: (Presented by Long Range Planner, Elizabeth Fewkes) A proposal to identify wildland urban interface (WUI) lots on final plats, permit vegetation removal allowances required by Utah Code, and add associated definitions.

17.	LEGISLATIVE ITEMS

	17.A.	UPDATE - Legislative Priorities List

18.	CITY COUNCIL/MAYOR'S BUSINESS AND LIAISON REPORTS
	This time is set aside for the City Council's and Mayor's comments on City business, and for Councilmembers to report on the boards they are assigned to as liaisons to the City Council. 

19.	COMMUNICATION ITEMS

	19.A.	Financial Report

	19.B.	Upcoming Agenda Items

20.	ADJOURNMENT

THE PUBLIC IS INVITED TO PARTICIPATE IN PUBLIC MEETINGS FOR ALL AGENDAS.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, Eagle Mountain City will make reasonable accommodations for participation in all Public Meetings and Work Sessions. Please call the City Recorder's Office at least 3 working days prior to the meeting at 801-789-6611. This meeting may be held telephonically to allow a member of the public body to participate. This agenda is subject to change with a minimum 24-hour notice.

CERTIFICATE OF POSTING

The undersigned, duly appointed City Recorder, does hereby certify that the above agenda notice was posted on this 15 day of October, 2026, on the Eagle Mountain City bulletin boards, the Eagle Mountain City website www.eaglemountain.gov, posted to the Utah State public notice website http://www.utah.gov/pmn/index.html.

Lacie A. Messerly
City Recorder

notices.title: ORD-45-2026 - Amending EMMC Chapters 9.10 and 17.47 Regarding Archery Use Within the City
notices.agenda_text:
ORDINANCE NO. O-45-2026

AN ORDINANCE OF EAGLE MOUNTAIN CITY, UTAH, AMENDING 
EAGLE MOUNTAIN MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTERS 9.10 AND 
17.47 REGARDING ARCHERY USE WITHIN THE CITY

PREAMBLE

WHEREAS the City Council of Eagle Mountain City finds that it is in the public interest to amend the Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapters 9.10 (Weapons) and 17.47 (Outdoor Shooting Range Overlay Zone), as set forth in Exhibit A to establish standards for the safe conduct of archery activities within the City.

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT ORDAINED by the City Council of Eagle Mountain City, Utah:

1.	The City Council finds that all required notices, public hearings, and other procedural requirements for consideration and adoption of amendments to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapters 9.10 (Weapons) and 17.47 (Outdoor Shooting Range Overlay Zone), as set forth in Exhibit A, have been satisfied.

2.	The amendments to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code Chapters 9.10 and 17.47 as set forth in Exhibit A are hereby approved and adopted.

3.	The City Council has considered the impact of this Ordinance on and found it consistent with family health, stability, and formation as required by Utah law.

4.	This Ordinance shall become effective immediately upon its passing.

ADOPTED by the City Council of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, this 6th day of October, 2026.
